activity.notes: The National Assembly invested Charles de Gaulle as President of the Council on 1 June 1958. He headed the government through the constitutional transition until he assumed the Presidency of the Republic on 8 January 1959. ATLAS normalizes President of the Council to the generic Prime Minister role and keeps this term separate from his 1959-1969 presidency.

sources.citation_text: The Élysée states that the National Assembly invested Charles de Gaulle as President of the Council on 1 June 1958.
